words.sanskrit: esha brahma esha indra esha prajapatih

meaning.en: this is brahman, this is Indra, this is Prajapati
meaning.hi: यह ब्रह्म है, यह इंद्र है, यह प्रजापति है

meaning.en: all these gods are this
meaning.hi: ये सारे देवता यही हैं

words.sanskrit: imani cha pancha-mahabhutani prithivi vayuh akashah apah jyotimshi

meaning.en: and these five great elements — earth, wind, space, water, light
meaning.hi: और ये पाँच महाभूत — पृथ्वी, वायु, आकाश, जल, प्रकाश

words.sanskrit: etani imani cha kshudra-mishranivba bijani itarani cha itarani cha

meaning.en: and these countless small, mixed-together things, every kind of seed
meaning.hi: और ये अनगिनत छोटी, मिली-जुली चीज़ें, हर तरह के बीज

words.sanskrit: andajani cha jarujani cha svedajani cha udbhijjani cha

meaning.en: whatever hatches from an egg, is born from a womb, breeds in moisture, or pushes up from the ground
meaning.hi: जो अंडे से, गर्भ से, नमी से, या ज़मीन से जन्मता है

meaning.en: horses, cattle, people, elephants
meaning.hi: घोड़े, गाएँ, मनुष्य, हाथी

words.sanskrit: yat kincha idam prani jangamam cha patatri cha yat cha sthavaram

meaning.en: every breathing creature, whatever walks, flies, or stays rooted in place
meaning.hi: हर साँस लेती चीज़, जो चलती, उड़ती, या जड़ है

meaning.en: all of it has knowing as its eye
meaning.hi: इस सबकी आँख जानना है

meaning.en: it rests on knowing
meaning.hi: यह जानने पर टिका है

meaning.en: knowing is the eye of the world, and knowing is what the world stands on
meaning.hi: जानना ही संसार की आँख है, जानना ही उसका आधार है

meaning.en: knowing is brahman
meaning.hi: जानना ही ब्रह्म है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. This verse contains the famous declaration prajnanam brahma, "knowing is brahman."

words.sanskrit: sa etena prajnena atmana asmat lokat utkramya

meaning.en: through this very self which knows, rising up and out of this world
meaning.hi: उसी जानने वाली आत्मा के सहारे इस लोक से ऊपर उठकर

words.sanskrit: amushmin svarge loke sarvan kaman aptva

meaning.en: obtains everything desired in that world above
meaning.hi: ऊपर के उस लोक में जो चाहा था सब पा लेता है

meaning.en: and becomes deathless, becomes deathless
meaning.hi: और अमर हो जाता है, अमर हो जाता है
